title: Weapons Full Potential
description: Unlocks the full potential of swords making them more powerful but harder to obtain.
body:
-My first minecraft mod :D-

Weapons:

Full Potential Wooden Sword: 8 Attack Damage

Full Potential Stone Sword: 9.5 Attack Damage

Full Potential Iron Sword: 11 Attack Damage

Full Potential Gold Sword: 11.7 Attack Damage

Full Potential Diamond Sword: 12.5 Attack Damage


Blocks/Items:

1. Compressed Oak Log
   
2. Log Stick
   
3. Compressed Log Stick
   
4. Compressed Cobblestone
   
5. Fully Compressed Cobblestone
   
6. Compressed Iron Block
   
7. Compressed Gold Block
   
8. Compressed Diamond Block

Additional:

1.Craftable Debug Sticks.
